listings.name: Viejas Casino & Resort
listings.blurb: East County's big one — huge floor, The Willows hotel, outlets, and DreamCatcher shows.
listings.description: Just off I-8 in Alpine, Viejas pairs a sprawling casino floor with the AAA Four-Diamond Willows Hotel & Spa, an outlet center next door, and live concerts at the DreamCatcher showroom. A San Diego County heavyweight.

listings.name: Sycuan Casino Resort
listings.blurb: Freshly expanded — 12-story hotel tower, pools, and a serious dining lineup.
listings.description: Sycuan's major expansion added a 12-story hotel tower, resort pools, a spa, and a dozen restaurants on top of a big gaming floor. One of the most complete casino resorts in the county.

listings.name: Barona Resort & Casino
listings.blurb: Ranch-style resort with its own 18-hole championship golf course.
listings.description: Set on a ranch in Lakeside, Barona is known for its full resort feel, an 18-hole championship golf course, and a big, easygoing gaming floor. A favorite for a golf-and-gamble weekend.

listings.name: Harrah's Resort Southern California
listings.blurb: Home of the Dive pool complex and Caesars Rewards in Valley Center.
listings.description: In the town it literally renamed 'Funner,' Harrah's SoCal brings the Caesars playbook to North County — the massive Dive Lagoon pool complex, concerts, and a big rewards-driven floor.

listings.name: Pala Casino Spa & Resort
listings.blurb: North County resort with a full spa, outdoor pool, and big-name concerts.
listings.description: Tucked into the hills of Pala, this AAA Four-Diamond resort pairs gaming with a full-service spa, a resort pool, and a strong outdoor concert calendar. Scenic and polished.

listings.name: Valley View Casino & Hotel
listings.blurb: Famous for its buffet — and one of the more comfortable floors in the county.
listings.description: Valley View has built a loyal following on the strength of its buffet and a smoke-conscious, comfortable gaming floor, plus a boutique hotel in the North County hills.

listings.name: Jamul Casino
listings.blurb: The closest full casino to downtown — a sleek multi-level floor ~20 min east.
listings.description: A modern, multi-level casino only about 20 minutes east of downtown San Diego. Compact, stylish, and the easiest full gaming floor to reach without leaving the metro.

listings.name: Casino Pauma
listings.blurb: A scenic, no-frills local favorite in the North County backcountry.
listings.description: Smaller and refreshingly low-key, Casino Pauma is the backcountry local's pick — great mountain views, loose vibes, and a floor that never feels overwhelming.

listings.name: Golden Acorn Casino
listings.blurb: Off I-8 near Campo — a classic road-trip stop with slots and a travel center.
listings.description: Out east near Campo, Golden Acorn is the quintessential I-8 road-trip casino: slots, a diner, and a travel center. Perfect for a stop on the way to or from the desert.

listings.name: Addison
listings.blurb: San Diego's only three-Michelin-star restaurant — the special-occasion pinnacle.
listings.description: Chef William Bradley's Addison in Del Mar is San Diego's only three-Michelin-star restaurant: a multi-course tasting-menu experience that's the region's undisputed fine-dining summit. Book well ahead.
listings.tam_quote: Three Michelin stars in our backyard. If you do one bucket-list dinner in San Diego, make it Addison.

listings.name: The Marine Room
listings.blurb: Oceanfront fine dining where high tide crashes on the windows.
listings.description: A La Jolla legend: white-tablecloth dining right at the waterline, where high-tide waves crash against the windows. Time a reservation with the tide charts for the full show.
listings.tam_quote: Book it at high tide. Watching waves slam the glass over dinner is peak San Diego romance.

listings.name: Born & Raised
listings.blurb: Glam Little Italy steakhouse with tableside service and a rooftop bar.
listings.description: An old-school-glam steakhouse in Little Italy: tableside Caesar and bananas Foster, dry-aged cuts, and a gorgeous rooftop for a martini before or after. Dress up a little.

listings.name: Juniper & Ivy
listings.blurb: Richard Blais's inventive Little Italy flagship — get the 'In-N-Haute' dessert.
listings.description: Top Chef winner Richard Blais's Little Italy flagship: playful, refined California cooking in a soaring converted warehouse. Save room for the 'In-N-Haute' riff on a fast-food classic.

listings.name: Ironside Fish & Oyster
listings.blurb: Little Italy's stunning oyster hall — piranha-skull wall and all.
listings.description: A show-stopping seafood hall in Little Italy: a raw bar stacked with oysters, a wall of piranha skulls, and a mermaid mural. Great for a lively dinner or a happy-hour dozen.

listings.name: Puesto
listings.blurb: Cult-favorite Mexican street tacos — the crispy cheese potato taco is unreal.
listings.description: San Diego's beloved taco spot for modern Mexican street food. The filet mignon and crispy cheese-crusted potato tacos have a genuine cult following. Locations in La Jolla, Mission Valley, and the Headquarters.

listings.name: Hodad's
listings.blurb: Ocean Beach's legendary surf-shack burger joint since 1969.
listings.description: A San Diego institution in Ocean Beach: massive, messy, bacon-crowned burgers served in a surf-shack plastered with license plates. Come hungry, expect a line, embrace the chaos.

listings.name: The Buffet at Valley View
listings.blurb: Long regarded as the best casino buffet in San Diego County.
listings.description: Crab legs, prime rib, a global spread, and a dessert station that people plan their week around. Valley View's buffet has topped 'best casino buffet' lists in the county for years.

listings.name: The Buffet at Sycuan
listings.blurb: A revamped spread with carving stations, seafood nights, and Sunday brunch.
listings.description: Sycuan's remodeled buffet brings carving stations, themed seafood nights, and a big weekend brunch to East County. A solid, sprawling casino-buffet experience.

listings.name: Noble Experiment
listings.blurb: Text for a reservation, then find the door hidden behind a wall of kegs.
listings.description: San Diego's original hidden bar: text for a reservation, arrive at Neighborhood in East Village, and slip through a wall of stacked kegs into a jewel-box room of gold skulls and craft cocktails.
listings.password_hint: Text for the reservation, then look for the kegs

listings.name: False Idol
listings.blurb: A tiki temple hidden behind a walk-in freezer door in Little Italy.
listings.description: One of the country's best tiki bars, hidden behind a walk-in freezer door inside Craft & Commerce in Little Italy. Ambitious rum cocktails, thunderstorm effects, and full-on tiki theater.
listings.tam_quote: Push through the freezer door at Craft & Commerce and you're in the best tiki bar in California. Order the volcano bowl.
listings.password_hint: Through the freezer door at Craft & Commerce

listings.name: Raised by Wolves
listings.blurb: A hidden vault bar behind a rotating gin display — inside a UTC mall.
listings.description: An award-winning cocktail bar and bottle shop in UTC that hides a jewel-box vault lounge behind a rotating antique gin display. Genuinely one of the best cocktail programs in the country.
listings.password_hint: Find the rotating gin display in the back

listings.name: Prohibition
listings.blurb: A basement jazz den in the Gaslamp behind a fake law-office door.
listings.description: Head down the stairs off Fifth Avenue, past the 'Eddie O'Hare, Attorney at Law' door, into a dim 1920s jazz lounge with live music nightly and a no-photos rule that keeps it magic.
listings.password_hint: Look for the 'law office' door on Fifth

listings.name: The Grass Skirt
listings.blurb: A tiki hideaway in Pacific Beach behind a working poke shop.
listings.description: Walk into a poke shop in Pacific Beach, step through the disguised door, and land in a moody tiki grotto with a hidden pool wall and seriously good rum drinks.
listings.password_hint: Through the poke shop's back door

listings.name: Vin de Syrah
listings.blurb: A whimsical, Alice-in-Wonderland cellar bar hidden in the Gaslamp.
listings.description: Find the unmarked door with the grass wall in the Gaslamp and descend into a whimsical, storybook wine-and-spirit garden — moss walls, quirky nooks, and weekend DJs.
listings.password_hint: The grass-covered door on Fifth Avenue

listings.name: The Comedy Store La Jolla
listings.blurb: The legendary club's SD outpost — big touring names in an intimate room.
listings.description: The San Diego chapter of the legendary Comedy Store books national touring headliners into an intimate La Jolla room. Grab a two-drink-minimum table and settle in.

listings.name: Humphreys Concerts by the Bay
listings.blurb: Open-air bayfront concerts on Shelter Island — the summer ticket.
listings.description: An intimate outdoor amphitheater right on the water at Shelter Island. Warm nights, boats in the marina, and a summer lineup of major touring acts. The quintessential SD summer show.

listings.name: The Old Globe
listings.blurb: Tony-winning Balboa Park theatre — Shakespeare to Broadway-bound premieres.
listings.description: A Tony Award-winning theatre in Balboa Park with a storied outdoor Shakespeare festival and a track record of launching Broadway-bound shows. San Diego's cultural anchor.

listings.name: Belmont Park
listings.blurb: Beachfront boardwalk park with the 1925 Giant Dipper wooden coaster.
listings.description: A beachfront amusement park on the Mission Beach boardwalk, anchored by the historic 1925 Giant Dipper wooden roller coaster, an arcade, mini-golf, and ocean-view eats. Pure San Diego fun.
listings.tam_quote: Ride the Giant Dipper at sunset, grab a churro, walk the boardwalk. Cheap, classic, so San Diego.

listings.name: Topgolf San Diego
listings.blurb: Climate-controlled hitting bays, food, and drinks in Mission Valley.
listings.description: Three levels of tech-tracked hitting bays in Mission Valley with a full food-and-drink menu. Great whether you golf or just want cocktails, music, and a competitive night out.

listings.name: K1 Speed
listings.blurb: Indoor electric go-kart racing — real speed, real adrenaline.
listings.description: High-speed indoor electric karting with timed races and leaderboards, at locations around the county. A reliably fun group outing or date-night wildcard.

listings.name: La Jolla Sea Cave Kayak & Snorkel
listings.blurb: Paddle the sea caves and snorkel with leopard sharks in the Cove.
listings.description: Guided kayak tours of the La Jolla sea caves and the Ecological Reserve, with summer snorkeling among harmless leopard sharks, sea lions, and bright orange garibaldi. Bucket-list San Diego.

road_trips.name: Temecula Wine Country
road_trips.blurb: 40+ wineries, hot-air balloons, and Old Town — an easy San Diego day trip.

road_trips.name: Julian
road_trips.blurb: Historic gold-mining mountain town famous for apple pie and fall color.

road_trips.name: Coronado Island
road_trips.blurb: The Hotel del, a golden beach, and a bayfront bike path minutes from downtown.

road_trips.name: Valle de Guadalupe
road_trips.blurb: Baja's booming wine country — world-class food and desert vineyards. Bring a passport.

road_trips.name: Palm Springs
road_trips.blurb: Mid-century modern, pools, and desert nightlife — the classic weekend escape.

road_trips.name: Anza-Borrego Desert
road_trips.blurb: California's largest state park — spring wildflowers and jaw-dropping dark skies.
